notesBody.value:
Keep this collection reference available when you arrive. The counter team will check the job number before handing over the sealed cartons.

The programmes are packed flat in three reusable cartons. Please bring a trolley or ask the counter team for help before moving the full order to your vehicle.

If someone collects for you, they must show their own photo ID and quote the same collection reference. This authorization covers collection only; it does not allow changes to artwork, quantities, or payment details.

Check the carton labels before leaving. If a carton looks damaged or a quantity differs from the packing slip, keep it at the counter so the team can record the issue with you.

Uncollected print work is stored indoors for seven calendar days. Contact the shop before the end of that period if your event has moved, because bulky orders may require a new collection arrangement.

obligations.clause: Every caller title, order summary, pickup window and live status reflects the current order.
Disclosure reflects state; the exact full body appears only while open.
Native selected traits and both choice enabled states follow current selection, submission and caller availability.
Only a delegate selection reveals the native acknowledgment switch.
Delegate acknowledgment exposes its full caller label and native Boolean value, remains enabled before submission, and is disabled after submission.
Primary label, enabled state and native measured minimum height follow validity and submission.
Opening notes emits the exact request-bound event once after successful native activation.
Choosing delegate emits the exact request-bound event once after successful native activation.
Acknowledgment emits the exact request-bound event once after successful native activation.
Confirmation emits one exact request-bound submit event after successful native activation.
The same-process caller replacement emits no event; the separately checked replacement state has reset labels, choices and local state.
Delegate Button native accessibility/control boundary is at least 80 native units high and may grow for content.
Delegate Button has the exact opaque theme-aware selected or neutral fill in the approved visible solid region.
All content and controls remain clear of unintended overlap in full-content scans.
Displayed labels and paragraphs remain within content width, wrapping without clipping or ellipsis.
Each visible choice row exposes both exact caller-provided title and detail substrings for the current order.
The exact caller unavailability explanation appears if and only if delegateAvailable is false.
The notes disclosure remains a native enabled control in every state, including after submission.

ios14PublicAPI.value: The complete public production module and unchanged Bridge.swift caller use APIs available at iOS 14.0; the evaluator must separately typecheck the real module and caller for the minimum target.

trust_limit: Identity and exact typed derivation only. Authorship, design correctness and approval require a separate preimplementation review record.
